how: Collective invitations recruit members to draw particular Smash marks rather than merely announcing a finished work
A request for help outlining receives a bare commitment without a demand or explanation
A direct reply reports work on Yoshi in answer to the invitation to help
The outline invitation receives an unelaborated acceptance in the next turn without establishing a population rate or silent uptake

statement: Explaining participation before and during building
how: Instruction about the experiment and placing controls supplies a sensemaking process present on the ladder but unnamed among the standing elements
A capability question followed by an objection to covering art does not establish a judgment of insufficient hands
A shine proposer and a mapper supply starting roles that receive explicit uptake
The initial call precedes the design suggestion and asking can itself constitute starting so a distinct starter-to-call sequence cannot be established
Choosing emblems extends into disputes about how different Smash games should be represented
Members report starting actual pieces including a light-blue cell and the first digit of the lettering
Locations and layouts make proposals actionable while division into small areas distributes the drawing task
A proposal for lettering receives a mapped layout in its direct reply
A posted layout translates a suggestion into instructions without demonstrating unanimous or formally ratified agreement
Following current plans depends on information access because excluded or uninformed contributors can erase intended construction

statement: Moving plans between public threads and a planning chat
how: Public coordination and credit coexist with later chat planning whose invitations and instructions return to public threads
Work divisions reported exclusion and claimed leadership place this case within the admitted decided-order minority without challenging the cross-room majority claim

statement: Governing participation through access to a planning chat
how: Permissions and exclusion attempt to regulate who may change shared work while independent placers explicitly reject the chat's right to bind them
A chat army and attack calls do not identify machine placement and inaccessible planning leaves automation unresolved
Repair calls overnight anti-grief requests and a switch from expansion to upkeep repeatedly prioritize keeping existing work
The shine account edits its completion announcement into an explicit repair call while building continues elsewhere
Members trace overwriters and send them the plan to correct interference rather than treating every changed pixel as hostile
Observed defense pressure cannot establish a turn to machines without a coded machine-use passage
Border compromises and a treaty constrain proposed additions to avoid conflict
A participant carries a neighboring group's border-compromise request without evidence of formal diplomatic appointment
Members reject covering existing art and appeal to the labor already invested in neighboring marks
The treaty is explicitly offered as the reason to shorten the kick and stop its further extension
Help includes offers promised spare pixels and reciprocal thanks without proving every offer was fulfilled
The shortage mechanism does not explain outgoing help explicitly justified by local stability and therefore cannot cover every maintenance-to-help relation
Confidence in local stability permits allocating spare pixels to a less stable neighboring work
A claim to space and an accompanying help offer do not show that an accepted border agreement caused an exchange
Contributors invoke an alliance and retrospectively name a wider coalition while its internal formation remains unseen
Goon is reported to have received space for helping and later relocation assistance when the hosts needed room
Reported accommodation supports the host-and-guest relation but does not reconstruct a settled host authority or its full approval procedure
Coexisting repair pressure and border requests do not establish that erosion caused the negotiation
Alliance recollections and defense calls do not date joining or identify common attack as its cause
Reports of helping neighbors move do not show relocation of the room's own mark after erasure
A capability question and relocation of neighbors cannot establish shortage causing an own-room move
An independent placer explicitly denies being bound by alliances or the planning chat
An alliance defense receives an immediate reply asserting freedom outside agreements which exposes contested authority over individual placements
Game lore and locally recognizable references shape proposals and disputes about representation without establishing shared ideology
An internal game-community schism does not establish a preexisting inter-room quarrel carried into a canvas attack
The coded border and red-shield attack calls do not supply a prior tie naming the opponent
Generic replacement flairs and names license collaborative play beyond simply deceiving readers
A play license is contested through authenticity tests and objections to particular jokes rather than uniformly accepted
A claimed restoration failure extends the prank before a later confession reestablishes limits on moderator deception
Members dispute whether canvas posts need a megathread and moderators later remove ended-event and duplicate posts
Repeated design posts explicitly motivate a request to contain canvas talk
A proposed posting boundary can be declined because the event is temporary or the posting wave has already subsided

statement: Continuing ordinary activity alongside event performances
how: Tournament reporting and game advice coexist with event performances without requiring a canvas-produced return to routine

statement: Recruiting for ordinary moderation during the prank aftermath
how: Ordinary moderator recruitment continues through questions about responsibilities and a commitment to apply without evidence that the canvas created these roles
Members celebrate completion credit small contributions and name collaborative achievement repeatedly before and after placement ends
Completion is explicitly joined to celebration and can become the stated occasion for choosing another target
Final-work posts mark the technical end and present the room's contribution without requiring inspection of linked images
Co-present celebration and final-work presentation do not establish marking as the cause of recording
Members contest retrospective accounts of Goon and Discord by recalling assistance and defending the chat's promotion of change
Keeping prank flairs concerns the separate host joke and does not establish continuation of the canvas effort
A final-work post and retained prank styling cannot establish a canvas-record-to-lasting-effort transition
Particular members call for border encroachment or retrospectively claim destruction without establishing a unified attack policy
Independent placers' attacks cannot automatically be attributed to room policy when they explicitly reject the room's alliances
An earlier building invitation and later attack calls establish order without showing that mobilization caused the attacks
Restraint can answer an addition that would unintentionally cover allied work rather than only an explicit attack on a known rival
Existing alliance obligations can redirect a proposed addition without requiring the attack to produce new border negotiations
The strongest hostile exchange concerns internal alliance authority and does not establish rival rooms carrying a contest in talk
A destruction claim and an internal authority dispute cannot demonstrate attack causing inter-room taunting
Anticipation of subreddit changes and planned pranks precedes the visible takeover without establishing an effect on canvas organizing
Official-looking game announcements and parody ranking formats sustain a parallel practice of staging claims for other members to elaborate or test
